notes: The kernel array contains a named constant (`Literal`) that the regex word extractors (audit_modes.words_of, disasm.words) silently drop, shifting every later word by one; use words_file (generated/, built by substituting the constexpr value) — the manifest's alu_word_range is in true word indices and matches words_file.

rows expr is a closed form of Run()'s 64-bit LCG (state = state*6364136223846793005 + 1442695040888963407, word = state>>32, 2 words per lane); checked lane-for-lane against a compiled copy of the test's FillInput().
main() runs the same words twice: Run(waveSize=32) and Run(waveSize=64), Check() after each. This file is the wave64 run; the sibling Vop3CarryOut.CarryOutCode.json is the other.
In wave64 the VOP3 carry destinations s8/s10/vcc_lo name s[8:9]/s[10:11]/vcc (still below s48).
Lane tid reads Input[tid*4+0..1] = a,b (Edges[tid][0..1] for tid<14, else LCG); Edges columns 2..7 are expected values, not inputs; words 2,3 are 0.
Outputs v10..v25 -> Output[tid*16+0..15] (value, carry pairs); Check() asserts all 16 columns.

The manifest's '[gfx1013 only]'/invalid flags for this kernel came from the dropped Literal shifting decode; with the true words every instruction (v_add/sub/subrev_co_u32 VOP3, v_cndmask_b32_e64, literal 0x80000000) decodes on gfx1030 and gfx1036.
